retry_basis: Attempt 1 ended AUDIT_PENDING after no model event or verdict before timeout.

evidence_decomposition.rule: Do not open the large rejected v1 symbol manifest or inspect any embedded symbol, month, object, timestamp, hash, path, row, or value. The v2 model result is the authoritative substantive summary of why v1/v2 failed; byte hashes establish preserved file identity only.

required_decision: Return one complete DIRECTION_ACCEPTED or REVISION_REQUIRED verdict for the same exact draft. Review its provenance, request grammar, reconstruction, causal universe, artifacts, sufficiency, resource, failure, audit, and zero-performance rules using the decomposed evidence set.

provenance_and_preservation: prior verdicts immutable and rejected v1 manifest ineligible
new bytes required for every v3 observation
raw responses bind decoded listing and object metadata
request_and_holdout_guard: root delimiter request cannot admit nested Contents
transport and identity guard reject full-symbol and 2026 object queries
object_and_row_reconstruction: object key ETag size last-modified ZIP checksum and hash bindings
timestamp header Decimal OHLCV duplicate revision and ZIP safety rules
raw-only independent reconstruction and cross-artifact arithmetic
causality: gap episodes identity uncertainty and fresh buffers
strictly lagged liquidity and last-bar non-use
exact next-bar delay synchronization delisting and terminal fail-closed rules
governance_and_resources: bounded requests bytes cycles memory retries and resume
failure precedence repair audit and terminal classifications

open the rejected v1 symbol manifest
